pillars.heading: Two ways we support your business

items.title: People & Talent
items.tagline: Get the right people doing the right work — tracked, accountable, and delivered.
items.description: Whether you have an idea that needs to become a product, or a growing team that needs qualified talent fast — we put the right people in place. And with our built-in task management layer, you always know exactly what's happening, no matter where in the world your team sits.

items.title: Business Operations
items.description: Finance. Legal. Sales. Compliance. These are the departments every business needs but few early-stage companies can afford to build in-house. We handle all of it — so you don't have to.

detailed_services.label: The IBOT Model
detailed_services.headline: IBOT: Identify. Build. Operate. Transfer.
detailed_services.body: Ottobon connects talent development with real-world business delivery through a structured talent lifecycle. Our Academy focuses on identifying and building talent, while Professional Services focuses on enabling client engagement and potential long-term hiring.
included: 1. Identify: Identify suitable candidates for relevant technical roles.
2. Build: Develop technical capabilities in Python, AI, Cloud, and other relevant technologies through Ottobon Academy.
3. Operate: Enable selected talent to contribute to client work through a defined engagement arrangement.
4. Transfer: Provide a potential pathway for clients to hire suitable candidates permanently following an agreed evaluation period.

detailed_services.label: Business Development
detailed_services.headline: We fill your pipeline. You close the deals.
detailed_services.body: From market research and lead generation to pre-sales support and pitch preparation — our BD team works as an extension of your own sales function. We don't just hand you leads; we build the foundation for sustainable growth.

detailed_services.label: sBLOOM — Digital Growth
detailed_services.headline: Grow Your Digital Presence. Generate More Leads.
detailed_services.body: We help businesses strengthen their online presence, reach the right audience, and turn digital marketing efforts into meaningful growth.
included: Lead Generation: Attract potential customers and create more opportunities for enquiries.
Digital Front Office: Build a stronger online presence across your website and digital channels.
Digital Marketing: Reach relevant audiences through focused digital marketing campaigns.
Brand Positioning: Communicate what makes your business valuable and different.
Go-to-Market Strategy: Plan how to introduce your offerings to the right customers and markets.

detailed_services.label: Operation Support
detailed_services.headline: Deliver Consistently. Scale Confidently.
detailed_services.body: Manage people, track work, and maintain quality—without the daily firefighting. Our operational support services are designed to keep your projects on track and your teams aligned, so you can focus on growth instead of getting bogged down in the details.

detailed_services.label: Legal, Finance & Regulatory
detailed_services.headline: Stay legal. Stay Compliant. Stay operational.
detailed_services.body: Our team ensures every financial, legal, and regulatory requirement is handled with precision—so your operations stay stable and audit-ready. We provide the expertise and infrastructure to manage these critical functions without the overhead of building in-house teams.

detailed_services.label: Ottobon TalentOps: Hiring Agency
detailed_services.headline: Skip the Resume Noise. Hire Pre-Vetted Professionals on Demand.
detailed_services.body: Stop wasting countless hours interviewing the wrong candidates. Our proprietary two-tier screening utilizes neural-engine AI and real human experts to evaluate candidates on technical depth, core values, and cultural compatibility. We do the heavy lifting so you only meet the top-tier.
included: Automatic filtering of up to 60% of unqualified applicants
Real-time technical screening via adaptive neural-engine AI
Rigorous final evaluation by internal human tech experts
Precision semantic matching for technical and cultural alignment
Immediate access to exclusive, pre-vetted talent pools

secret_sauce.heading: Human expertise. AI efficiency. Full transparency.

And across all talent engagements, our task management infrastructure gives clients real-time visibility into what's being done, by whom, and when.
